title: French Empanada Fritters
description: A crispy French twist on the classic Uruguayan empanada, made with a flaky pastry crust and a savory filling.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the onion and garlic mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of thyme and a sprinkle of Gruyère cheese on top of the filling.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Fry the empanadas in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
